title: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
titleEn: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
description: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy is a story-heavy adventure and tactical RPG created by teams led by Kazutaka Kodaka and Kotaro Uchikoshi. Fifteen students are forced to defend the isolated Last Defense Academy from grotesque invaders for 100 days. Between tactical battles, players explore, spend free time with classmates, build relationships, craft gifts, and make choices that can lead to a very large number of story outcomes.

gameplayPillars.title: Tactical defensive battles
gameplayPillars.description: Grid-based SRPG encounters ask the class to stop invaders using each student’s specialist skills.

gameplayPillars.title: 100-day narrative structure
gameplayPillars.description: The calendar and repeated defense cycle create constant pressure while the larger mystery slowly unfolds.

gameplayPillars.title: Free-time relationships
gameplayPillars.description: Spend time with classmates to deepen bonds and learn more about their personalities and histories.

gameplayPillars.title: Exploration outside the school
gameplayPillars.description: Players can investigate wilderness and ruins beyond the academy between major attacks.

gameplayPillars.title: Branching choices and endings
gameplayPillars.description: Decisions can redirect the story dramatically, making replay and route exploration a central appeal.

worldSummary: The game contrasts an isolated school protected by supernatural barriers with dangerous ruins and wasteland outside, building a closed-community mystery over a fixed 100-day period.

storyChapters.title: Takumi’s normal life collapses
storyChapters.body: Takumi Sumino’s ordinary life ends when grotesque monsters attack and a strange creature offers him power.

storyChapters.title: Enter Last Defense Academy
storyChapters.body: Takumi awakens at the isolated academy alongside fourteen other students drafted into the Special Defense Unit.

storyChapters.title: Survive repeated invasions
storyChapters.body: The students must defend the school while learning how their specialist abilities work in tactical combat.

storyChapters.title: Build bonds and uncover secrets
storyChapters.body: Free time, exploration, and personal interactions reveal hidden motives and the truth behind the academy.

storyChapters.title: Reach radically different outcomes
storyChapters.body: Choices across the 100 days can lead into dramatically different routes and endings.

features: Large branching narrative with many outcomes
Distinct cast of fifteen student defenders
Free-time bonding, exploration, and gift crafting
Digital Deluxe package includes art book and soundtrack

faq.q: Is The Hundred Line a tactical RPG?
faq.a: Yes. Tactical defensive battles are a major gameplay pillar, combined with adventure and visual-novel storytelling.

faq.q: Why is the game called The Hundred Line?
faq.a: The central premise tasks the students with defending the academy for 100 days.
Yes. Branching choices and many routes are a major part of the game’s identity.
No. The Nintendo Switch release is a single-player game.

faq.q: What does the Digital Deluxe Edition include?
faq.a: Official store descriptions include the base game plus a Digital Art Book and Digital Soundtrack.

verdictPros: Strong mix of tactical battles and character drama
Distinct creators bring recognizable narrative style
verdictCons: Very long if exploring many routes
Heavy dialogue will not suit action-focused players
Some tactical battles are simpler than dedicated strategy games
Dark themes and violence limit audience
Repetition is unavoidable when pursuing route variations
